reviews.review: Boring, grindy game. Makes Dynasty Warriors look like a masterful RPG.
I'm AlwaysEdging, and this is my favorite game on the Citadel.

Scung in its purest form. If your the kind of person who Likes Yukes/Tamsoft/Cavia/Simple Series (Bullet Witch, Onee-Chanbara, etc) Games you will probably enjoy this. Biggest issues is that this is a roguelike which feels more like it is starting you off incomplete and then upgrading gets you the abilities you _should_ have had at the start, and it is _Very Repetitive_ in the long run.

To be EXCEEDINGLY CLEAR: 5/10 game. But recommend if you like this kind of of mid budget trash (non-derogatory). Only on sale though, Full price is way too much.

Solid fun game, nothing mind blowing, incredibly overpriced for what it is I feel.

I got it in a bundle, which meant I paid $10.00 for it, at that price point it's great lol

Great game so far. Probably only worth $20-30. Requires skill to actually get higher in the tower, and honestly if you do not have skill this might be a grind to get back to where you were when you ultimately fail.

Game runs constant 120+fps at max settings even on weaker hardware. Mouse and Keyboard controls are well done, though some basic things like better jump are a thing you buy later with currency. 

Specific weapons and balancing are broken. If you can aim some weapons are so good you can use a lvl1 versions while you are expected to be using lvl30 guns.

Game feels like a game. Simple story, repeat lines of dialogue, etc. You are here to kill, level up some, get to the end. Turn up difficulty, go again. If you suck, you have to restart, so do not suck.

Its worth playing but it would have been so much better if it keys weren't one time use. Seriously, talk about artificially extending game time.

Gave it some more time and honestly, the key thing was bad enough but this game would have been so much better as a classic beat-em-up adventure game with a set, consistent progression. The Rogue-like elements get in its own way so much its frustrating.

I think the biggest thing everyone forgets (or maybe don't know) is that each game of rogue was the WHOLE game. Starting again was an entire playthrough. This isn't and having to constantly cross my fingers on good rolls for things is tiring. I understand the progression becomes easier as you unlock more items and upgrades but it is so repetetive and demoralizing.

I'm starting to like the game buuuttt....
There are no save points unless you are in the main menu.
I was at floor 35 then died, elevator key is not permanent so you go back to the lower floors if you die or retire, worst part is you go back to the the very first floor then you need to repeat the process again from the very beginning. Floor 11-30 was more than an hour without any save points. Imagine you are at higher floors then you die;start again at floor 1. Really bad game design for a game that you need to tackle every floor.
You can't even save your progress once you enter.

If you don't have a job/life, this is perfect for you to waste your time. Very repetitive.

Got this game as part of a bundle, wouldn't pay full price $49.99 for it. It's fun for bit, but I can't run it long. I keep getting Fatal Error crashes when playing for a while. Since you can save until you fail or quit, it ruins the fun. Until the crash issues are fix and the current price being too high with all of the worthless DLC. I wouldn't recommend it.

Very well-made game in DX3D12 and optimized.

Fluid gameplay with a constant FPS rate.

Complete configuration and FPS rate selection.

5-star game with configuration options for various PCs.

Excellent addition to your game library.

Fun and very well-constructed game story.

tl;dr i say give it a shot, the humble bundle with tons of other silly D3 games was definitely worth for $25.

that was awesome, honestly. surprisingly polished compared to some of D3's other offerings (cough Ed-0, all love, i wanna beat that, too) probably thanks to Yuke's as the dev
i'm not super versed in the CHARACTER ACTION BIBLICAL CANON AND PLATONIC IDEALS so i'm not really the guy to judge action mechanics but all the stuff i enjoy is here. backstep canceling out of dash attacks then shotgunning enemies you send flying, varied (but not deep) movesets for all the weapon types, weaving between guns and melee to juggle ammo vs energy felt great thanks to the weakpoint targeting

it never devolved into a parry fest or i-frame spamming dodge rolls, which, if i understand the temperature check on the genre's fans complaining lately, people might like? energy for attacking and stepping IS a stamina bar though, there are perfect dodges, and there is a "parry" for reflecting homing missiles back at enemies. love it or hate it, there IS a meta progression aspect to this for stats and such, so be warned if that turns you off as a purist. or praise be, if you like slamming your head into walls when you lose. it's pretty quick to get everything unlocked.

i also loved the cheesy VA, had a really fun energy to the entire game.

as far as complaints, i think the punishment attacks could've been made a bit better, some felt pretty useless/niche while others like the shining finger sword obliterate everything....
the game also DESPERATELY needs a quicksave between floors like a normal roguelike, these runs can get LONG especially if you run out of keys. not a huge issue by the end but in the mid 50s when i lost it was pretty devastating starting from the beginning, which ironically isn't a problem in most NORMAL roguelikes but in a roguelite action game like this it stood out, since you're essentially doing a 100 floor gauntlet broken up into chunks that most games of the type would throw into the postgame

Legit dont understand the hate for this game, is fun as ♥♥♥♥ super worth it.
just buy it or wait for promo

I had fun playing this, enough that I 100% all the achievements. It's pretty basic though in terms of rougelike mechanics, so hardcore rougelike fans might not find it as interesting/too simple/not enough variety.

While I enjoyed this, I totally understand if price-conscious people want to wait for a sale.

reviews.review: do not play this game.

If you can get the game at a price that's alright for your wallet, there's some pretty solid hours of dumb fun to be had here.

It's not a complex or 'deep' game by any means, but if you know what you're in for, it might hit the spot more-or-less perfectly.

It's fun to play (shoot, smash, dodge. What's not to like?) but it ias brought down by a lack of refinement in certain aspects. It's very basic in terms of upgrades which seldom feel worth it. This does not make the gameplay less engaging, but in this genre feeling like you found or dropped something interesting is an important aspect and here things are most of the times underwhelming. You get a reward for each room you clear but 90% of the times it doesn't matter and on the race up you are only hoping to drop your favourite weapon or a heal pack.

With the negative out of the way, I had tons of fun and loved my 20 hours climb to the top of the tower. The characters are silly but I am sillier so I can't complain about that, as this game falls in the category of "what I am looking for". I am the audience.

The price is WAY too high but I got it in a bundle and I was very happy about it.
It is fun to play but you need to be "a certain audience", otherwise there are better games.

You know what it reminds me of? Returnal. Which is 10000 a better game than this, but if you have already played that and you are a weeabo, then try and get this game cheap and enjoy it for what it is.

I've had lots of fun playing this so far!! i wanted this game when it first came out but the bad reviews scared me of haha.. i do understand the bad reviews since i wouldnt pay full price for a game like this. i think the game is meant to be a fan service game but i dont really see that? the game is fun, simple and east to understand although it can get a bit repetitive. If you are looking for a fanservice shooter i dont recommend this but if you are looking for a fun simple game with cute girls you should get it !!

Heads up to Steam Deck players; no idea why this is unsupported, low settings + high AA seems more than fine?

This is otherwise a bog standard 3D hack and slash. very repetitive and a dumb plot. Feels like a budget Hi Fi Rush, but that game oozed style and was hella inventive. This is just passably fine at best, and horribly bland at worst. Worth it in a bundle, but alone... *maybe* wait for $20 or $15.
Zenshin Machine Girl!!

Simply enjoyable, a way a video game should be, simple, fast , over the top and just plain fun. The game cycle is enjoyable, the grind is fun, the mechanics are sound and best of all, it just feels right, the way the weapons work, the enemies behave and how you have that ''just one go'' feeling all over you.
i admit, it has issues, the fact that you can't quit a run and then resume is weird, i reached floor 50 in one go but had to leave, didn't get a key for that floor, so i had to quit, not fair. The weapons are cool, but a couple more would be nice, mods aren't all useful, and some are so much more helpful and the rng most of the times work against you.
Other than that, i am sure the only issue is the $50 asking price, the only reason i got it was that it costs me around $2.77 , that was a 9 games bundle for $25, so i said ''heck, gonna get a 50% discount on this game and get 8 other games with it ? that is a great deal''.
if this game is $30 and u get it with a discount for around $20 to $25, it would be a great deal, but $50 for such a basic but fun game is too much.
that is why, always check sites, getting this for honestly $2.77 was an insane good deal and i still didn't touch the other 8 games, because i am playing this a lot and happy about it.

tldr: it's not worth playing, even if it was way cheaper. If the game goes 90% off, I don't think it's worth it.

Anime girls and robots, I was so excted! Sadly it is REALLY underbaked.
- Movement feels bad.
- Very repetitive voice lines, would be better not to have any.
- Forced cutscene every few minutes. For a game about hack and slash, I want to be sprinting around, dodging and shooting, not forced camera pan at a treasure chest that contains 5 rupees.
- nitpicking but limited controls (only offers toggle sprint, not hold sprint. only offers hold aiming not toggle. no separate option for ADS/scope sensitivity).

Some parts that are good. The UI was actually pretty good, not often i say that. Weak-points are easily indicated while still adding to enemy design. All the feedback around shooting looked great.

This is just a really mid cyberpunk game. You get modded. You go after corpos. You want reveange. 

C'mon choom. Johnny silverhand is calling. 

But forreal. It's alright. Not the worst game I've played. Def not the best. Not really super lewd, although so far they've tried to hamstring little weird things in. 

Overall it's repetative, and solidly okay, but fun as a random shoot em up. For added fun put on pumped up kicks on repeat.

Game runs really good and is fun. It gets a little repetitive but the fun factor is still there. The higher floors get harder but it isn't too unreasonably hard. The story is pretty simple and good and the soundtrack is very nice. Very good, would recommend.

Full metal schoolgirl is a game that I didn't realise was a tower climbing rougelite but honestly I'm glad I didn't, it was a fun, silly experience with some surprisingly cool and silly moments, as well as a heck load of weapons, some a lot better than others, in a ways to it's detriment but not enough that it's a bad time dood.

So the game focuses on two characters, Ryoko and Akemi who you will have to make sure to think on who to choose carefully, for reasons o3o and they have a personal gripe with the head of the company you are invading and it's living dead employees! Who are just like cyborg workers essentially dood.

The gameplay consists of climbing up 100 floors, all bar the boss rooms off which are randomly generated, it's established early on that the layout is pretty nutty so despite a quick glance at a companies review of the game (won't mention the three letter name wink) it does have a reason for dead ends, heck sometimes there's little lucky cats filled with money so worth it! Still they are filled with traps and rooms with multiple enemies to destroy dood!

A big aspect of the game is that it's being viewed live and your viewers will ask you to do certain combat requests, another thing the company reviewer mocked (I have a very bad view of this company as is but yeesh) because sometimes it will ask you for things that may seem impossible for the higher cash chat, which is the main reason to do them, money and upgrades! But frankly viewers are like that normally in real life but also it's more like a quick time event, you glance the room, you look at your weapons and you ask yourself, "can I do this harder task? Or should I just take the lower risk money?" and in that way it's actually a great way to push a player to either git gud and take on the hard challenge for more views and money or realise yes the viewer is a troll and this is impossible, better to not take the risk and it adds variety to the combat outside of shooty bang, slice times! dood

You have a decent selection of guns and melee weapons to choose from, ranging from chainsaws, hammers, katana, Gatling guns, grenade launchers, rifles, drones and more, each one having different types and uses to them, whether they do a lot of damage to single units or rip through a bunch all at once or even get stronger as you shoot! There's some fun unique ones in there, could there have been more? Yes and some could be a bit more fine tuned or damaging or less damning to use but there's enough there for a 100 floor run dood.

The game also half does something I like, you can in fact get elevator/lift cards! Which will take you to a set point in the dungeon, what I will say though is that it honestly feels better to do a full 100 and has some benefits to doing so, especially with how difficult higher floors would be with base equipment on, that and redoing bosses has new dialogue and funny moments I highly appreciated on a personal level, although it reminds me of a half issue for the game, every boss you beat forced you back out but in return you always get a special upgrade to get so it's very give and take like that, I do wish it gave the option to keep going though, especially later on dood.

So I talked about the good but I do want to talk about the kinda bad and what could be done better, so melee weapons are kind of way too weak outside of the hammer, often times you'd be safer and kill things quicker or as fast using the guns, granted there's still a reason for melee outside of that but the risk reward is very low for general use, on top of that there are variations that can be too weak or a huge burden, I was a hammer user overall but the amount of times it gave me the extra super heavy deluxe hammer that made you unable to do anything but walk very slowly or run which takes energy was...frustrating when there were two other more usable hammer types to use, same with the guns and getting the more awkward to use grenade launchers or special guns which could be great or just awful to use dood.

I feel a good fix for this would be the option to remove certain weapons from the pool, even if it was at a cost or limited, as all too often I would be stuck with much weaker weapons than I could have because the game decided I really reaaaally should have the grenade launcher that shoots 8 sticky shots out with the accuracy of a stormtrooper who's highly drunk about 20+ times which is yes! Very grating and spending 1000 and one of my 10 re-rolls on a new weapon is not ideal by any means dood.

The music's pretty decent and the upgrades are actually pretty useful which is rare for these kinds of games I feel compared to the usual here's a very slight improvement that you can't feel! That said the start with stronger gear upgrade was kind of lame, if anything I feel it should be replaced with a higher chance of better tier boxes as an upgrade, something actually helpful for more than the first ten floors dood.

Talking about boxes, you have grey, green, blue, purple and yellow ones, in that order of rarity and what comes out is random but don't think ya can cheat that by quitting and reloading the floor, they are loaded in as the floor is XD (yes I tried! lol) it's very looty shooty dood.

And that's about all I have to say really, is it the most amazing game ever? No it could in fact use a liiittle sprucing up but is it fun? Yes and if the devs give it a little more love and fine tuning it could most definitely be a super fun game dood.

Thank you for reading and if you but the game I hope you have a great time dood! ^-^7
